# Calibration-target datasets for the U.S. Geological Survey National Hydrologic Model (version 1.0)

This data release provides curated calibration-target datasets for the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) National Hydrologic Model (NHM). The release is organized as an umbrella collection of 2 child items: ECMWF ERA5-Land Reanalysis (consolidated for NHF); Calibration targets for the gfv2 hydrologic fabric, U.S. Geological Survey National Hydrologic Model.

## Purpose

Provide reproducible, provenance-tracked calibration targets for parameter estimation of the USGS National Hydrologic Model.

hydrology, National Hydrologic Model, calibration, water cycle

None. Users are advised to read the dataset's metadata thoroughly to understand appropriate use and data limitations.
